title: Construction.
bodyText: This part shall be liberally construed to effect the purpose under section 431:16-202 which shall constitute an aid and guide to interpretation.
bodyHtml: §431:16-204  Construction.  This part shall be liberally construed to effect the purpose under section 431:16-202 which shall constitute an aid and guide to interpretation. [L 1987, c 347, pt of §2]
